SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_display, a.mobile, a.email, a.status, a.created_time, p.person_code, p.person_name, o.org_code, o.org_name, pos.post_code, pos.post_name, creator.account_display as created_name FROM exp_account a LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON a.person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit o ON a.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post pos ON a.post_id = pos.post_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON a.created_by = creator.account_id
AND a.account_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%')
AND p.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personName}, '%')
AND a.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mobile}, '%')
ORDER BY a.created_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exp_account a LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON a.person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit o ON a.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post pos ON a.post_id = pos.post_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON a.created_by = creator.account_id
AND a.account_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%')
AND p.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personName}, '%')
AND a.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mobile}, '%')
